dslRule:
<!id: java.source.hover.enable.shift.up>
<!description: Migrate calls to createInformationControlCreator to use the new 'doShiftUp' parameter, setting it to true.>
<!severity: HINT>

createInformationControlCreator($isResizable, $statusFieldText)
=>
createInformationControlCreator($isResizable, $statusFieldText, true)
;;
summary: Adds 'true' as the third argument to calls to `createInformationControlCreator`.
